b.title: HACK THE BAY 2026!
b.description: Berkeley Startup Club and Cal Hacks present Hack the Bay, our 24-hour student hackathon. Doors open at 10am, hacking starts at noon. Build with AI and climate data, pitch to a judging panel of founders and investors from Berkeley SkyDeck, and compete for $10k in prizes. Open to all college students; no experience needed.
